name: MongoDB Atlas
one_liner: Managed cloud MongoDB service; Atlas Administration API manages projects, clusters, users (not cluster data).
auth_notes: Service accounts via OAuth2 client credentials (POST /api/oauth/token, 1h bearer) recommended; API keys use HTTP Digest (legacy). Optional per-org IP access list (403 if not listed). Admin API does not read/write cluster data; the Atlas Data API is end of life.

oauth_details.app_review_required: no (service accounts self-created by Org Owner)

access_notes: Any Atlas account holder who is Organization Owner can create service accounts or API keys; no sales or approval step is stated. Free M0 tier exists. Whether Admin API works on M0 not separately verified.

buildability.rationale: Documented admin API with self-serve service accounts, but per-org setup by an Org Owner, optional IP access list, and no data-plane access: reading documents needs a DB user and connection string, not this API.

disputes.why: Docs require only an Atlas account and Org Owner role to create service accounts; free M0 tier listed; no paid gate stated.

disputes.first_pass: Admin API vs Data API unresolved
disputes.yours: Administration API; Data API is End of Life
disputes.why: Data API docs page is titled End of Life; Admin API does not access cluster data.
API 'allows developers to manage all components in MongoDB Atlas'; count unverified, so confidence medium.

auth.quote: Service accounts are the recommended authentication method and API keys are considered a legacy option.

access.quote: To create a service account or API keys for an organization, you must have Organization Owner access to that organization.

sandbox.quote: | M0 | 512 MB | Shared | Shared | Free forever |

api_surface.quote: The MongoDB Atlas Administration API allows developers to manage all components in MongoDB Atlas.

mcp.quote: A Model Context Protocol server for interacting with MongoDB Databases and MongoDB Atlas.

buildability.quote: The Atlas Administration API doesn't provide access to the data stored in your clusters.
If you make a request to the Atlas Administration API without an IP access list entry, the server responds with a 403 status code.

identity.quote: Atlas Data API [End of Life] - Atlas App Services - MongoDB Docs
